claims.statement: If G is 4-sunflower-free, G+e is not iff there are three distinct old edges whose three pairwise intersections and three intersections with e are exactly the same set.
claims.proof: A new sunflower must contain e; the other three edges are old, and conversely six equal intersections construct one.

claims.statement: For any triple e not in F39 (on an arbitrary ambient set) there are two 4-sunflowers in F39+e, each containing e, and with their respective three old petals disjoint as sets of edges. In particular no deletion of one old edge allows insertion of e.
